title: Unique Player Behaviors
description: Sheep! Monkey! Dragon! Bee! Unleash the power of the Soul and harness the powers of your Spirit Animal
body:
This mod adds 5 charms giving you unique abilities


Wooly Charm: Turns you into a Sheep-Person, letting you eat grass and sheer yourself for wool! Nether grasses give you buffs.
Sweet Charm: Turns you into a Bee-Person, letting you collect pollon from plants and craft honeycombs
Primal Charm: Turns you into a Monkey, giving you the ability to climb and enhanced physical strength
Infernal Charm: Turns you into a Dragon-Person, letting you shoot fireballs
Soggy Charm: (Work In Progress) Turns you into a ??? letting you use Water Magic to breath under water and throw water spheres.
